keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across the filing (matches the registrant's name and filing text). Leave blank for all new S-1 filings market-wide.

includeAmendments.title: Include amendments (S-1/A)
includeAmendments.description: By default only original S-1 filings are returned (new IPO registrations). Turn this on to also include S-1/A amendments to already-filed registrations.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by filing date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of filings to return, most recently filed first.
